title: fanoutqa: Did Sedol Lee win the Go game against Alpha Go? (cfe8f23b3e45113c)

chat_history.content: Did Sedol Lee win the Go game against Alpha Go?

content.content:
The user asks: "Did Sedol Lee win the Go game against Alpha Go?" They likely mean Lee Sedol (Korean professional Go player) vs AlphaGo (DeepMind AI). The match was in March 2016, a five-game match; Lee Sedool won one game (Game 4). So answer: He won one of the five games, but lost the match 4-1. Provide context.

We need to answer succinctly, factual. No need for external tool. Could also mention that later he played a new version and lost.

Provide answer.

content:
Lee Sedol (often written **Lee Sedol**) faced Google DeepMind’s AI program **AlphaGo** in a five‑game match in March 2016.  

- **Result of the match:** AlphaGo won 4 games, Lee Sedol won **1 game**.  
- **Which game he won:** Lee Sedol’s victory came in **Game 4** (the only game he won in that series).  

So, while Lee Sedol did secure a single win against AlphaGo, he did **not** win the overall match; the final score was **AlphaGo 4 – Lee Sedol 1**.  

(After that, a later version of AlphaGo (AlphaGo Master) played a “re‑match” with Lee Sedol in 2017, and AlphaGo won that game as well.)
